messages:
Harper: Heads-up — Townsend tunnel underpass is leaking steady. Saw a scooter battery spark and a small crowd helping push it out. If you're coming from Caltrain side, there's a puddle-zone detour. :umbrella: :zap:
Luis: Oh no. Just got rerouted at 4th & King. Security waved everyone through the loading ramp instead. Shoes are now stadium-grade soggy. :sneaker:
Mei: I left a spare pair of socks at concierge (size 7). Also grabbed a box of silica packs from my desk for damp electronics. Pro tip: rice is old-school, silica is the new hero. :package:
Dana: Anyone know if shuttles are running? My bike lock is drenched and Im contemplating a cab. :thinking_face:
TransitBot: Caltrain alert: https://caltrain.example/alerts/216777 | 4th/King area: temporary pedestrian detour due to water ingress at underpass. Expect 10-30 min delays for surface connections.
```
service: shuttle_4thking
status: detour
cause: water ingress at tunnel
est: 10-30 mins
```
Benji: I ended up trading my rain jacket for a coworkers poncho at the stop. Good karma exchange. Also helped push a very apologetic scooter off the tracks. Scooter owner bought everyone hot chocolate. Commute morale restored. :hot_beverage: :raised_hands:
Harper: Legend hot chocolate hero. Also shoutout to Facilities who placed floor mats at the detour entrance 20 minutes after we tweeted them. Facilities = unsung commute MVPs. :trophy:
Luis: Micro-poll: does the office want a small "commute repair kit" shelf? Suggestions: silica packs, ziplocks, small trash bags, spare socks, towel. React :wrench: for yes, :shrug: for nah.
Mei: :wrench: Also add cable ties and a tiny toolkit for bike fixes.
Dana: :wrench: and pocket hand warmers. My fingers are still drying.
Benji: If you need a lift from 4th & King, I have two seats. Leaving in 7. Honk once if youre meandering.
Harper: Leaving a sticky note at concierge: "For soggy commuters: socks + silica". If you take something, please drop a thank-you emoji. Folks, stay careful around the tunnel—slick metal plates are sneaky.
Luis: Arrived in. Socks = savior. Towel donor, you are a saint. :pray:
Mei: Follow-up: added a quick note in #random-pinned with a map of detour spots and a Facilities contact. If you ran into anything weird, drop a one-liner here so I can include it.
Benji: Also, minor triumph: rescued a stranded MetroCard from a puddle with a chopstick. Victory for small things. :confetti_ball:
Harper: Commute status closed. Tunnel drip tamed for now. Big thanks to rescuers, hot chocolate financier, and everyone who shared supplies. See you dry(ish) at your desks. :sun_behind_rain_cloud:
